text:
maria: quick check — we started seeing a burst of 429s from hosted when clients refresh tokens. pattern: 401 (token refresh) -> immediate retry -> 429. It looks like some clients re-run the same request without idempotency header. anyone seen this?

ashok: yep saw similar in telemetry last week. two things: 1) clients that blindly retry streaming start frames can produce duplicate side effects, 2) Retry-After header from gateway is sometimes missing so clients do their own backoff.

sam: for non-streaming writes we recommend Idempotency-Key. for streaming we recommend resume tokens + dedupe server-side. we should make the guidance explicit in SDKs.

maria: agreed. current ask: propose a minimal change to Go + JS SDKs so default retry behavior avoids immediate hammer after refresh. ideally: on 401 we refresh token, wait a small jittered backoff before retrying the original request.

kai: suggested backoff algorithm: full-jitter exponential backoff (initial=100ms, cap=30s, maxRetries=6). if server returns Retry-After use that. reset backoff on 2xx. also special-case: if we detect token refresh race (401 then auth-refresh event within <200ms) add extra 200-500ms jitter.

ashok: +1. also add a check: if request has side effects (method != GET && no Idempotency-Key) then avoid automatic retry after refresh — bubble up an auth error to caller and let app decide.

sam: propose concrete snippets for README. Go example: 
```go
// naive full-jitter backoff helper
func backoff(attempt int) time.Duration {
  base := 100 * time.Millisecond
  cap := 30 * time.Second
  max := math.Min(float64(cap.Milliseconds()), float64(base.Milliseconds())*math.Pow(2, float64(attempt)))
  sleep := time.Duration(rand.Int63n(int64(max))) * time.Millisecond
  return sleep
}
```

maria: nice. JS snippet for clients using fetch: 
```js
async function retryWithJitter(fn, attempt){
  const base = 100; const cap = 30000;
  const max = Math.min(cap, base * Math.pow(2, attempt));
  const delay = Math.floor(Math.random() * max);
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
  return fn();
}
```

kai: also add a short section: "When to set Idempotency-Key" — any request that mutates state (payments, DB writes) should require caller-provided idempotency key; SDKs can auto-generate for convenience but warn users.

maria: streaming nuance: for canonical streams (chat/generation) we should: 1) preserve resume tokens or chunk offsets from the server, 2) upon transient 5xx/429 try reconnect with exponential backoff and include resume token, 3) if reconnect still fails and client hasn't acknowledged server-side side effects, surface a recoverable error with guidance to re-run with idempotency if available.

sam: question: do we want SDKs to automatically attach a lightweight "x-retry-safety" header so server can make decisions? e.g. x-retry-safety: idempotent|non-idempotent|unknown

ashok: I like that. server can use it to avoid double applying. We should reflect this in API contract. small impact on existing calls.

maria: open to bikeshedding but we need something ship-ready. action items:
- ashok: add small PR to go-sdk to implement the 401+refresh jitter and respect Retry-After (target PR by EOD)
- sam: update docs + add code samples for Go/JS on idempotency and streaming reconnection (target tomorrow)
- kai: sketch header proposal x-retry-safety and send to api-design (target today)

sam: I'll also add a short integration test: simulate auth refresh flow and assert we don't retry mutating requests automatically.

devex-bot: Reminder: create tasks and link PRs to the "sdk-retries" epic :) :thumbsup:

maria: tagging @ashok for review when ready, and thanks everyone. keeping this thread to track decisions.

ashok: ping — created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/348 (adds jitter on refresh + respects Retry-After). tests included.

maria: reviewing now. quick note in PR: add explicit doc comment for behavior on non-idempotent requests.

sam: merged docs PR to staging. added examples for resume token usage in the streaming guide.

kai: sent x-retry-safety proposal to api-design thread. summary: three states, header optional, server default safe fallback = treat unknown as non-idempotent.

maria: great. we'll check telemetry for 429 drop after these changes. thanks all :rocket:
